items.title: Why Is Oracle (ORCL) Reworking Its AI Plans After A $7 Billion Deal Ended?
items.summary: Oracle (NYSE:ORCL) reportedly cancelled a planned US$7b AI chip leasing agreement with Tencent after increased U.S. government pressure. The shelved arrangement involved providing Nvidia processors to Tencent through Oracle's cloud infrastructure for Chinese AI workloads. Deloitte announced a unified Oracle business group that brings together its Oracle consulting, implementation and managed services into a single unit. The scrapped Tencent chip deal and Deloitte's new Oracle-focused group...

items.title: AI data center stocks and Musk's companies take hits as Democrats take control
items.summary: The 8:30 hosts, Pras Subramanian, Jake Conley, and Defiance ETFs CIO Sylvia Jablonski, break down the latest market headlines, including the Democrats retaking Congress and its possible negative effects on AI stocks and Elon Musk's companies. Plus, the team dives into the stocks to watch: CVS (CVS), McDonald's (MCD), Meta (META), and Uber (UBER).
